bosses.name: Warden of the Verdant Hollow
variants: The forest does not forgive. It only remembers.
You step where I do not step. A grave mistake.
The roots have been waiting for you, hunter.
I am the wall between your life and the wild.
Last one walked this path. It is still walking.

bosses.name: Crimson Lord
variants: Your blood will be the last offering.
I have eaten a thousand of your kind.
The fen runs red tonight, and it is your fault.
You dare enter the Fen of the Crimson Lord?
My throne is built from your bones, soon enough.

bosses.name: Bone Sovereign
variants: You shall kneel before the throne of bone.
Death is my servant, and you are my meal.
The spire rings with a hundred thousand voices, and now yours.
I do not die. I merely wait for the next.
You came for the crown. You found the grave.

bosses.name: Plague Baron Malachar
variants: Breathe deep. The miasma is my welcome gift.
Every drop of water here is a disease I cultivated.
You will rot before you reach me. They all do.
The swamp swallows the living. I merely watch.
Your flesh will feed the next generation of pestilence.

bosses.name: Frost Empress Yuki
variants: Feel the cold. It is the last thing you will feel.
The ice remembers every intruder. It preserves them.
My palace is built from the screams of the frozen.
You bring warmth? How quaint. I will extinguish it.
The tundra does not forgive. Neither do I.

bosses.name: Shadow King Nyx
variants: You cannot fight what you cannot see.
The darkness is not empty. It is me.
I have been your shadow since you entered.
Every light you carry is borrowed. I will collect.
The crypt has no exit. Only deeper rooms.

bosses.name: Inferno Duke Azrak
variants: The flames hunger. You are the feast.
I was forged in the heart of the world. You were forged in fear.
Burn. It is the only honest end.
The lava remembers no footprints. Only ash.
You came looking for treasure. You found the furnace.

bosses.name: Abyss Tyrant
variants: The dark does not care for your name.
I have devoured stars. You are a morsel.
The abyss is patient. It was never patient before today.
You will not see the bottom. Neither will your eyes.
The dark remembers you, even now, before you are dead.

bosses.name: Storm Herald Tempest
variants: The mountain speaks in thunder. Listen.
I am the wind that tears the peak from the valley.
Lightning does not strike twice. It strikes once, and you are gone.
You climbed high. The fall will be longer.
The storm does not negotiate. It takes.

bosses.name: Void Reaper
variants: I harvest the space between thoughts.
You exist. I will not. That is the test.
The void is not empty. It is hungry.
Nothing you carry crosses this threshold.
Silence is my blade, and it cuts clean.
